tree.heading: Failure To Maintain Qualifications or To Comply.—
tree.text: The Federal Maritime Commission, after notice and opportunity for a hearing, shall suspend or revoke an ocean transportation intermediary’s license if the Commission finds that the ocean transportation intermediary—

children.text: is not qualified to provide intermediary services; or
willfully failed to comply with a provision of this part or with an order or regulation of the Commission.

tree.heading: Failure To Maintain Bond, Proof of Insurance, or Other Surety.—
tree.text: The Commission may revoke an ocean transportation intermediary’s license for failure to maintain a bond, proof of insurance, or other surety as required by section 40902(a) of this title.
